description: Keeps the digest-pinned base images, the pinned GitHub Actions and the pinned CI tool versions current. Cargo and npm dependencies are deliberately not managed here (lockfiles are reviewed by hand).

packageRules.description: The Rust toolchain, Node and the PostgreSQL test matrix move with rust-toolchain.toml, flake.lock and the support policy, never on their own; digest refreshes of the pinned tags still flow through.

customManagers.description: Tool versions annotated with `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...`: release.yml (KEY: "version") and the Dockerfiles (ARG KEY=version).
ci.yml tool versions, matched by name because ci.yml carries no annotations.
